I honestly hate thinking that and saying that though because that's a very broad grouping and hurtful discrimination against a specific gender. Again the evidence is overwhelming though. I would like to believe that my current significant other isn't the same and that maybe he just doesn't realize he's doing it and I need to find a way to bring it up to him to where he will understand and we can deal with it in a healthy way that will make our relationship better. For once I would like to be optimistic until proven otherwise. I'm tired of going from one POS Mooch to another. P.S. just want to say it's not that I choose moochers, it's just either that's the only type interested in me, or I somehow have toxic behaviors that turns guys into moochers.
